title: Piece Concertante
identity: Hermann Reutter, Pièce concertante for alto saxophone and piano, composed 1968. Schott ED5893 has three sections, Exposition, Berceuse, Combination, runs about 11 minutes, and was premiered by Jean-Marie Londeix and Daniel Spielberg in Geneva on 9 December 1969.

evidence.claim: Schott product catalog gives instrumentation, sections, duration, composition year, premiere credit, and 20 pages.
EDA Records lists the three recorded sections under Reutter’s 1968 piece.

review_focus: Inference: the publisher’s three contrasting section labels and the 11-minute duration make the work’s overall pacing and contrast worth checking in the score.
collection_flag: Original saxophone-and-piano work; publisher credits premiere to Londeix and Spielberg.

listening.description: EDA Records catalog lists Exposition, Berceuse, and Combination.
listening.verification: Recording catalog identified; playback not auditioned.

gaps: Score preview was listed but not accessible in this review; notation, range, and detailed demands remain unverified.
